items.content:
Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
PAPERS, PLEASE — LEARNED NOTES (observed unless marked guess)

CONTROLS / UI
- Documents arrive on the window sill (~0.15, 0.72–0.79); drag one to the desk ('DRAG DOCUMENTS HERE') to open and read it.
- RETURN a document by dragging it UP INTO the window opening (drop ~y0.42). Dropping on the sill, counter lip, black hand-off bar, or desk edge does NOT return it (many failures).
- NEXT!/call control = black box on the pole near top-center (~0.30, 0.22). Tooltip cycles slogans ('NEXT!', 'ARSTOTZKA WELCOMES YOU', etc.); it is also the advance control that dismisses an inspected entrant.
- Gold lever on the window frame (~0.30, 0.335–0.36) TOGGLES the shutter (open/close). It does not dispatch entrants. Order that worked: click NEXT!, then lever to open shutter, entrant approaches. Entrant may take a couple seconds; documents appear on the sill a moment later.
- Drags near the window can accidentally hit the lever and close the shutter mid-work; if the shutter shuts, the entrant is hidden and docs can't be taken until reopened. Verify shutter fully up before grabbing docs.
- Stamp drawer: click/drag tab at far right edge (~0.99, 0.44). If the rail doesn't appear, clicks at the very edge with imprecise coords can miss; retry near same spot. Rail shows red DENIED (head ~x0.66–0.72, y0.37–0.44) and green APPROVED (head ~x0.85–0.89, y0.37).
- STAMPING MECHANIC: drag the passport so the dashed ENTRY VISA box's TOP EDGE sits just below the rail bar and the box is centered under the chosen stamp head, then click the KNOB HEAD (APPROVED effective clicks ~(0.848–0.855, 0.36–0.37), failed at x0.885+; DENIED ~(0.655–0.665, 0.375–0.38)). Impression prints at a fixed screen spot just below the rail at that head's x. A mark landing at the box's top border/header, straddling the outline, was repeatedly ACCEPTED with no citation; marks landing higher on the page (above box) do NOT count. VERIFY by dragging the doc down after stamping. If no mark, re-align (top edge tight under rail) and click knob center again.
- Doc alignment requires repeated nudges; moving too far right can push the passport partly off-screen.
- Bulletin: page-turn by clicking the page corner at bottom-right (~0.78, 0.94) — this WORKED on the Day-2 bulletin (5 pages). The 'CHECK ALL PAGES' button did nothing. Park the bulletin in the bottom-left storage slot; parking it bottom-right can cover the red inspect-mode button (~0.965, 0.92).
- Day-2 bulletin contents: foreigners with valid passports permitted; check for discrepancies; deny inconsistent info/expired docs; INSPECT MODE (red desk button) highlights two discrepant pieces of info to enable interrogation; booth diagram lists Shutter (lever), Counter, Rule Book, Audio Transcript, Bulletin Storage, Time & Date. Audio Transcript noted but untested.
- Rulebook: drag book icon (~0.215, 0.85–0.90) from bottom toolbar onto desk. Map: Arstotzka home; Impor, Republia, Kolechia, Antegria, Obristan, United Federation foreign.
- Pause: Escape; options include HUDity checkbox, resume/main menu/quit.
- NO mid-shift save: only restart of the day recovers a stalled shift (Main Menu → STORY → day select).
- End-of-day: family screen with OK buttons, then ledger (SAVINGS/SALARY/RENT/HEAT/FOOD checkboxes ~x0.69; rent y≈0.575, heat ≈0.617, food ≈0.659) and SLEEP bottom-right (~0.92, 0.90). FOOD costs 20. On Day 1, slow processing left salary only 5, so FOOD was unaffordable and left unchecked. Day 2 ended early by a terrorist attack (family hungry; son sick, needs medicine); after SLEEP the screen went to black without a ledger being shown (unresolved whether ledger was skipped or still pending).
- Salary depends on processing speed; 'applicants entering after 6PM are unpaid' — process fast.
- Intro/next-day flow: letter → lottery → map → apartment → title card → newspaper with WALK TO WORK button; brief black fades between scenes.

RULES / CITATIONS OBSERVED
- Day 1 (1982.11.23): stamp ENTRY VISA; admit Arstotzkan citizens only; deny ALL foreigners (even valid passports).
- Day 2 (1982.11.24): foreigners with VALID passports admitted; deny expired documents (compare EXP to current date) or clear contradictions.
- Citations: denying over sex/appearance mismatch = warning; denying a passport whose small photo differed = −5 credits penalty; approving a non-matching-photo passport (entrant vs photo appearance) = WARNING only, no penalty. Lesson (evidence-based): tiny photos/appearance differences are unreliable — do NOT deny on appearance or subtle photo mismatch; approve when the document's internal data is consistent and unexpired. Deny only on clear contradictions (expired date, conflicting data).

ENTRANT OUTCOMES (correct unless noted)
- Day 1: Gunning (ARSTOTZKA, valid) approved; Borch (IMPOR) denied; Bernheim (REPUBLIA) denied; Sokolov (ARSTOTZKA) approved; a fifth entrant was never serviced before the shift ended.
- Day 2: Hwon (REPUBLIA, valid) approved; Walker (ANTEGRIA, EXP 1982.11.06 expired) denied; Teroska (KOLECHIA, valid) approved; Convanov (ARSTOTZKA, valid) approved; Belovska (KOLECHIA, valid, photo mismatch) approved → warning citation; Bernard (ARSTOTZKA, valid) approved; Stinson (UNITED FEDERATION, valid) was mid-inspection when the terrorist attack ended the day.
- Extra items: 'The Pink Vice' ad card and M.O.A. citation cards are not required documents; park them on the sill's right side so they don't block passport grabs.

UNRESOLVED / GUESSES
- Once the desk went dark and an entrant (hoodie man) never presented documents despite bell/shutter/wait cycles; cause unknown (guess: softlock from drags). Only a day restart recovered it.
- Guess (unverified): shutter must be open and documents returned before NEXT! reliably produces the next entrant.
- Inspect-mode red button never actually used; guessing it highlights two selected pieces of discrepant info.
- Unknown whether checking FOOD/FEEDING helps outcomes, and whether warning citations accumulate into penalties.
